title: "Dawn of the New Order"
next_chapter_hook: "When the first light of the new order fell upon the Three Realms, Chen Ji gaze instead into the unsolved riddle hidden within the depths of the Tianji Record — what he did not know was that the chess game of fate had never truly ended."

text.content: "As the embers of the Eye of Heavenly Law faded, the Three Realms trembled. That gaze, surpassing even the Observers, slowly withdrew. Chen Ji stood upon the ruins, the light of the Tianji Record behind him dimming by degrees, yet in its final moment it burst forth with a radiance it had never before possessed. The thousand-year chess game had finally reached its end. And he — this former waste of a menial servant — could at last shed every mask."

"Wind threaded through the crevices of the ruins, carrying the mingled scent of scorched earth and newborn life. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his hands — the Tianji Record Fragment once clutched there had now dissolved into scattered starlight, merging into every corner of the Three Realms. He had not become the master of Heavenly Law; instead, he had returned that power to all living beings. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded one last time in his ear: 'You made a choice I never anticipated.'"

dialogue.content: "'For a thousand years, countless inheritors chose to seize the power of the Tianji Record for themselves, becoming the new Heavenly Law. You are the first to choose to let go.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul faded gradually into the Void. 'Perhaps it is precisely for this reason that you were able to glimpse realms I could never foresee — those futures even the Tianji Record never recorded.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed toward where Mo Xiansheng had vanished, and for the first time revealed a genuine smile: 'Old man, even after leaving you couldn't say something nice. But… thank you.' He turned, his stride no longer deliberately slow as before, but suffused with a composure born of weathered experience. Beyond the ruins, the fate of the Three Realms was being rewritten."

"The Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate gleamed anew in the morning light. The once-desolate Servants' Quarters had become a place of paramount importance within the sect. The two characters '天青' on the plaque shimmered brilliantly under the sun. Su Qingyao stood before the Mountain Gate, her white garments whiter than snow, the sharpness in her brow replaced by the gentle luster of a guardian. Her gaze looked toward the horizon, as if awaiting someone's return."

dialogue.content: "'You've finally decided to come back.' Su Qingyao did not turn around, yet her voice trembled. 'All these years I've been wondering what you were scheming. Now I understand — you weren't scheming anything at all. You were simply守护ing everyone in your own way. Including me, back then, always giving you trouble.' She turned, her beautiful eyes glistening with tears."

text.content: "Chen Ji walked forward slowly, no longer maintaining the distance his 'waste' persona had demanded. He stopped before her and softly said: 'The great Inner Disciple Senior Fellow nearly demolished my Servants' Quarters back then — that debt, Chen has always remembered.' A rare tenderness curved his lips as he spoke. 'But now, you can just call me Chen Ji. No need to add any 'waste' prefix anymore.'"

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao laughed through her tears and gently punched him: 'You dead Chen Ji, still cracking jokes at a time like this.' Her eyes were still red, yet she smiled more brilliantly than ever before. 'But I like it.' In the morning light, the two stood side by side, a thousand years of entanglement dissolving in this moment into the purest understanding and companionship."

text.content: "Where the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path once stood, a sea of flowers now bloomed. As the sect's dark pall散去, Ye Qing stood in the heart of the blossoms, the demonic energy around her transformed into pure spiritual power. The title of Saintess, once forced upon her, had become her conviction to safeguard the peace of her domain. She gazed at the letter in her hand — it bore only four characters: '各自珍重' — Take care of yourselves."

dialogue.content: "'Take care of yourselves…' Ye Qing murmured softly, a knowing curve touching her lips. 'Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you truly calculated this step from the very beginning.' She tucked the letter into her breast, her gaze lifting toward the horizon. 'Rest assured, I will guard the Demonic Path for you. There will be no more pawns exploited by the Holy Sect.'"

text.content: "On the Xuanwu Sect Arena Platform, Han Lie brandished his halberd alone. Each strike carried a thunderous crack of displaced air, as if to shatter all former humiliations. Chen Ji's victory had not cast him into despair; instead, it ignited an even fiercer resolve. 'Next time, I will definitely defeat you.' He roared toward the heavens, his battle intent icy and resolute. This, perhaps, was the finest way for him and Chen Ji to coexist."

dialogue.content: "Deep within the innermost barrier of the Tianji Record, Chen Nian slowly opened her eyes. Her gaze was no longer hollow but gleamed with clarity and tenderness. 'Brother…' she whispered, tears sliding down her cheeks. The curse of the Heavenly Fate Lock had finally been lifted; she was no longer a tool in anyone else's chess game, but the true Chen Nian — the girl who had vanished years ago, who only wished to return to her brother's side."

text.content: "Chen Ji's consciousness awakened in the Void, and his first sight was the maiden standing quietly within the barrier. Her form was no longer blurred, but achingly real. 'Niannian…' His voice was hoarse; in this moment, all strategy and composure dissolved into the most primal familial affection. 'Brother is late.' Chen Nian shook her head and threw herself into his arms, weeping silently."

choice.prompt: "The reunion between Chen Ji and Chen Nian is about to unfold — how do you wish to present this brother-sister bond?"

choices.text: "Silence speaks louder than a thousand words."
choices.description: "Let Chen Ji express years of longing and guilt through the simplest of gestures — an embrace, a touch. Some feelings need no words."

text.content: "Chen Ji said nothing — he simply held his sister tightly. His palm gently stroked the crown of her head, just as he had countless times when they were children. Chen Nian wept in his arms like a child, and the grievances and fears of these many years dissolved in that moment into scalding tears. The wind among the ruins seemed to still; between heaven and earth, only this brother and sister remained, sharing a wordless communion."

choices.description: "Let Chen Ji finally speak the words buried in his heart all these years — his guilt toward his sister, his struggle against fate, and the unwavering resolve to find her that never wavered."

dialogue.content: "'Niannian, I've been searching for you all these years. Every time I used the Tianji Record, I tried to discern your whereabouts… but your presence always blurred the foresight. I thought my ability was insufficient. Now I understand — it was Heaven that did not wish me to find you too quickly. It wanted me to realize… that some things cannot be rushed.' Chen Ji's voice was low."

text.content: "Chen Nian raised her head, her tear-blurred eyes carrying a smile: 'Brother, I know everything. The Tianji Record showed me not just prophecies in the end… but every step you've taken over these years. You never gave up on me, did you?' Chen Ji reached out and wiped the tears from her face, nodding: 'Never. Nor will I ever.'"

"Beyond the barrier, a new order was quietly taking shape throughout the Three Realms. The Tianqing Sect no longer shut itself away in isolation but forged unprecedented alliances with every faction. The barriers between the Demonic Path and the Orthodox Ways gradually dissolved under the efforts of Ye Qing and Su Qingyao. For the first time, all living beings of the Three Realms felt true peace — not through hegemony and conquest, but through understanding and trust."

"Chen Ji stood within the core space of the Tianji Record, holding the final wisp of its radiance in his palm. The Heavenly Fate value had already fallen to zero; the Tianji Record had completed its purpose, yet Chen Nian's silhouette remained clearly by his side. A thought struck him, and he murmured softly: 'Mo Xiansheng said the Tianji Record was merely one of the pieces Heaven had set upon the board… then, apart from the Eye of Heavenly Law, who else has been watching this game?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji turned to his sister, his gaze carrying both inquiry and worry: 'Niannian, during those years at the Holy Sect, did you hear anything? About the Tianji Record, about our family… is there anything I don't know?' Chen Nian was silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: 'Brother, I met a person. He said… he has been waiting for us.'"

choice.prompt: "Facing the mysterious information revealed by Chen Nian, Chen Ji must make a choice:"

choices.description: "Having come this far, no mystery may remain unsolved. Whoever that person is, Chen Ji must meet him in person."

dialogue.content: "'He said his name is Chen Xuan.' Chen Nian's voice wavered slightly. 'He is our ancestor. He said the inheritance of the Tianji Record was no coincidence — the Chen family across generations have all been participants in the chess game… and you, Brother, are the only one who broke the game. So he wishes to meet you.'"

choices.description: "The new order has just been established, and all living beings need time to recuperate. Chen Ji decides to first consolidate peace in the Three Realms. If this mysterious person has waited this long already, he can wait a while longer."
choices.visible_reward: "Spend peaceful times with Su Qingyao and Chen Nian."

text.content: "Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then shook his head at last: 'No rush. If our ancestor has waited this long, he can wait a while longer.' He drew Chen Nian's shoulder close. 'Come — let me take you to meet your future sister-in-law. It's time you saw the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate properly.' Chen Nian first stared in bewilderment, then broke into a mischievous grin: 'Sister-in-law? Brother, when did you—'"

"No matter what choice Chen Ji makes, the new order of the Three Realms has been irrevocably established. The threat of the Eye of Heavenly Law has been vanquished; the power of the Tianji Record has merged into all living beings; and those former enemies and allies alike have each found new directions along their own paths. Ling Yuan's ambition crumbled beneath Chen Ji's designs. Han Lie's battle fervor found a fresh purpose. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist became a tool of protection rather than aggression."

dialogue.content: "Standing atop the Tianqing Sect Main Peak, Chen Ji cast one final gaze over this land where he had once endured for years in his disguise as a废物. The wind brushed across his robes, carrying away all calculation and pretense. At this moment, he was simply an ordinary person who could finally stop. 'Tianji Record, thank you.' he said softly. 'For letting me meet them, meet her, and find her.' A faint smile curved his lips. 'As for the future… who cares? One step at a time.'"
